2111.description: Inspects, maintains and repairs small arms such as rifles, machine guns and pistols.

2120.title: Ground Ordnance Maintenance Officer
2120.description: Warrant officer who manages ground ordnance equipment readiness, accountability and security.
2120.training: Ground Ordnance Maintenance Officer Course; Warrant Officer Basic Course

2131.title: Artillery Systems Technician
2131.description: Maintains and repairs towed artillery howitzers.

2141.title: Assault Amphibious Vehicle (AAV)/Assault Combat Vehicle (ACV) Repairer/Technician
2141.description: Maintains and repairs the automotive systems of AAV and ACV amphibious vehicles.
2141.training: AAV Repairer Basic Course or ACV Basic Repairer Course, Camp Pendleton, CA

2143.title: Amphibious Combat Vehicle (ACV) Technician
2143.description: Maintains and repairs the Amphibious Combat Vehicle family of vehicles.
2143.training: Amphibious Combat Vehicle Basic Repairer Course

2147.title: Light Armored Vehicle (LAV) Repairer/Technician
2147.description: Maintains and repairs Light Armored Vehicles (LAVs).
2147.training: Light Armored Vehicle Repair Marine Course

2171.title: Electro-Optical Ordnance Repairer
2171.description: Repairs night vision devices, lasers, optics and fire-control equipment.

2311.title: Ammunition Technician
2311.description: Receives, stores, issues and handles ammunition and explosives.

0511.title: MAGTF Planning Specialist
0511.description: Supports deployment and force planning, tracking units and requirements in planning systems.
0511.training: MAGTF Planners Basic Course, Dam Neck, VA

4502.title: Communication Strategy and Operations Officer
4502.description: Leads public affairs and communication strategy, engaging the media and the public.
4502.training: Public Affairs Communication Strategy Qualification Course, DINFOS, Fort Meade, MD

4503.title: Visual Information Officer
4503.description: Warrant officer and expert in visual information such as photo, video and graphics production.

4512.title: Combat Graphics Specialist
4512.description: Designs graphics, layouts and visual products for Marine Corps communication.
4512.training: Mass Communication Foundations (Graphic Design) Course, DINFOS, Fort Meade, MD

4541.title: Combat Photographer
4541.description: Shoots and produces still photographs that document Marine Corps operations and events.
4541.training: Mass Communication Foundations (Photography) Course, DINFOS, Fort Meade, MD

4571.title: Combat Videographer
4571.description: Films and edits video that documents Marine Corps operations and tells its story.
4571.training: Mass Communication Foundations (Videography) Course, DINFOS, Fort Meade, MD

6842.title: METOC Analyst Forecaster
6842.description: Observes, analyzes and forecasts weather and ocean conditions for military operations.
6842.training: METOC Analyst Forecaster Courses, Keesler AFB, MS

1650.title: Public Affairs Officer
1650.description: Leads Navy communications, media relations and community outreach.
1650.training: Officer Candidate School, then the Public Affairs qualification course at the Defense Information School.

mc.title: Mass Communication Specialist
mc.description: Tells the Navy's story through photography, video, writing and graphic design, and handles public affairs and media products.
mc.training: Boot camp, then 'A' School at the Defense Information School, Fort George G. Meade, MD.

mu.title: Musician
mu.description: Performs in Navy bands at ceremonies, community events and morale functions around the world.
mu.training: Boot camp, then about 21 weeks of 'A' School at the Naval School of Music, Virginia Beach, VA (audition required).

aircraft-handling-officer.title: Aircraft Handling Officer
aircraft-handling-officer.description: Senior aviation officer who directs the movement and placement of every aircraft on a carrier's flight deck and hangar.
aircraft-handling-officer.training: Not an entry job; reached after earlier aviation officer tours.

catapult-officer.title: Catapult Officer
catapult-officer.description: Flight deck officer who supervises catapult launches and gives the final signal to fire jets off a carrier.
catapult-officer.training: Officer Candidate School, air indoctrination in Pensacola, FL, then aviation maintenance training.

1310.title: Fighter Pilot (Naval Aviator - Jet)
1310.description: Naval aviator who flies strike fighter jets off aircraft carriers for air combat and strike missions.
1310.training: OCS (or Academy/ROTC), air indoctrination in Pensacola, FL, primary flight training, then the jet pipeline.

1310-fixed-wing-pilot-naval-aviator.title: Fixed Wing Pilot (Naval Aviator)
1310-fixed-wing-pilot-naval-aviator.description: Naval aviator who flies propeller and multi-engine aircraft for patrol, anti-submarine, early warning and logistics missions.
1310-fixed-wing-pilot-naval-aviator.training: OCS, air indoctrination in Pensacola, FL, primary flight training, then a fixed-wing pipeline.

1310-helicopter-pilot-naval-aviator.title: Helicopter Pilot (Naval Aviator)
1310-helicopter-pilot-naval-aviator.description: Naval aviator who flies helicopters for anti-submarine warfare, search and rescue, logistics and special operations support.
1310-helicopter-pilot-naval-aviator.training: OCS, air indoctrination in Pensacola, FL, primary flight training, then the helicopter pipeline.

1320.title: Naval Flight Officer
1320.description: Aircrew officer who runs navigation, sensors, communications and weapons systems in Navy aircraft and often leads the mission.
1320.training: OCS, air indoctrination in Pensacola, FL, primary flight training, then an aircraft-specific pipeline.

1520.title: Aviation Maintenance Duty Officer
1520.description: Manages aircraft maintenance programs, repair facilities and the Sailors who keep aircraft flying.
1520.training: Officer Candidate School, a 6-week air indoctrination course, then Aviation Maintenance Officer School in Pensacola, FL.

737x.title: Air Vehicle Pilot
737x.description: Warrant officer who flies the Navy's carrier-based unmanned aircraft, such as the MQ-25 Stingray refueling drone.
737x.training: Officer Candidate School, appointment as Warrant Officer 1, then roughly 15-18 months of flight and MQ-25 training.

abe.title: Aviation Boatswain's Mate - Launch & Recovery
abe.description: Runs and maintains the catapults and arresting gear that launch and catch jets on aircraft carriers.
abe.training: Boot camp, then about 5 weeks of 'A' School in Pensacola, FL.

abf.title: Aviation Boatswain's Mate - Fuel
abf.description: Operates and maintains aviation fuel systems and refuels aircraft on carriers and amphibious ships.
abf.training: Boot camp, then about 6 weeks of 'A' School in Pensacola, FL.

abh.title: Aviation Boatswain's Mate - Aircraft Handling
abh.description: Moves and positions aircraft on flight decks and hangar bays and leads crash, fire and rescue response.
abh.training: Boot camp, then about 4 weeks of 'A' School in Pensacola, FL.

ac.title: Air Traffic Controller
ac.description: Directs aircraft taking off, landing and moving through controlled airspace from towers, radar rooms and carrier control centers.
ac.training: Boot camp, then about 15 weeks of 'A' School in Pensacola, FL.

ao.title: Aviation Ordnanceman
ao.description: Stores, inspects, assembles and loads bombs, missiles, rockets and ammunition onto Navy aircraft.
ao.training: Boot camp, then about 9 weeks of 'A' School in Pensacola, FL.

awf.title: Naval Aircrewman Mechanical
awf.description: Serves as an in-flight technician and crew member who monitors aircraft systems, handles cargo and passengers, and supports maintenance.
awf.training: Boot camp, then Aircrew Candidate School in Pensacola, FL, plus follow-on aircrew training.

awo.title: Naval Aircrewman Operator
awo.description: Operates sensors and mission systems aboard maritime patrol aircraft to find and track submarines and surface threats.
awo.training: Boot camp, then 'A' School in Pensacola, FL, plus aircrew training.

awr.title: Naval Aircrewman Tactical Helicopter
awr.description: Crews MH-60R Seahawk helicopters, running sensors to hunt submarines and also qualifying as a rescue swimmer.
awr.training: Boot camp, Aircrew Candidate School and Rescue Swimmer School in Pensacola, FL, then follow-on training.

aws.title: Naval Aircrewman Helicopter
aws.description: Flies as a helicopter crew member, handling tasks like search and rescue, logistics, gunnery and other mission systems.
aws.training: Boot camp, then Aircrew Candidate School in Pensacola, FL, plus follow-on aircrew training.

awv.title: Naval Aircrewman Avionics
awv.description: Flies as a crew member who operates and troubleshoots avionics, sonar and communications gear during missions.
awv.training: Boot camp, then about 19 weeks of Aircrew Candidate School and AWV 'A' School in Pensacola, FL.

1200.title: Human Resources Officer
1200.description: Manages manpower, personnel policy, recruiting and training programs for the Navy.
1200.training: Officer Development School (5 weeks) in Newport, RI.

3100.title: Supply Corps Officer
3100.description: Runs the Navy's logistics, supply chains, contracting and financial management.
3100.training: Officer Candidate School in Newport, RI, then Supply Corps officer training.

az.title: Aviation Maintenance Administrationman
az.description: Keeps the records, schedules and paperwork that track maintenance on Navy aircraft.
az.training: Boot camp, then about 8 weeks of 'A' School in Meridian, MS.

cs.title: Culinary Specialist
cs.description: Plans menus, cooks and serves meals for Sailors and runs galleys and officer messes; the submarine version is CSS.
cs.training: Boot camp, then about 5 weeks of 'A' School at Fort Lee, VA; submarine CSS also attend Basic Enlisted Submarine School in Groton, CT.

ls.title: Logistics Specialist
ls.description: Orders, stores and tracks parts and supplies, handles related finances and runs postal operations; the submarine version is LSS.
ls.training: Boot camp, then about 9 weeks of 'A' School in Meridian, MS; LSS also attend Basic Enlisted Submarine School.

nc.title: Navy Counselor
nc.description: Senior enlisted career counselors and recruiters who advise Sailors on career options and help bring people into the Navy.
nc.training: Conversion rating for experienced petty officers; not a direct-entry job.

ps.title: Personnel Specialist
ps.description: Handles Sailors' pay, personnel records, travel claims and other administrative career actions.
ps.training: Boot camp, then about 5 weeks of 'A' School in Meridian, MS.

rs.title: Retail Services Specialist
rs.description: Runs ship stores, vending, laundry and barber services that support crew morale (formerly called Ship's Serviceman).
rs.training: Boot camp, then about 5 weeks of 'A' School in Meridian, MS.

yn.title: Yeoman
yn.description: Does office and administrative work such as correspondence, records and official reports for commands; the submarine version is YNS.
yn.training: Boot camp, then about 7 weeks of 'A' School in Meridian, MS; YNS also attend Basic Enlisted Submarine School.

5100.title: Civil Engineer Corps Officer
5100.description: Engineer officer who plans and manages Navy construction and facilities, and leads Seabee units.
5100.training: Officer Candidate School in Newport, RI, then CEC officer training.

bu.title: Builder
bu.description: A Seabee who builds and repairs structures using carpentry, masonry, concrete and roofing skills.
bu.training: Boot camp, then about 10 weeks of 'A' School in Gulfport, MS.

ce.title: Construction Electrician
ce.description: A Seabee who installs and repairs electrical power, wiring and distribution systems, including pole-climbing work.
ce.training: Boot camp, then about 20 weeks of 'A' School at Sheppard AFB, TX.

cm.title: Construction Mechanic
cm.description: A Seabee who maintains and repairs trucks, heavy construction equipment and their engines.
cm.training: Boot camp, then about 16 weeks of 'A' School in Port Hueneme, CA.

ea.title: Engineering Aide
ea.description: A Seabee who does surveying, drafting, materials testing and planning work before construction begins.
ea.training: Boot camp, then about 15 weeks of 'A' School at Fort Leonard Wood, MO.

eo.title: Equipment Operator
eo.description: A Seabee who drives and operates heavy machinery such as bulldozers, graders, cranes and trucks.
eo.training: Boot camp, then about 11 weeks of 'A' School at Fort Leonard Wood, MO.

sw.title: Steelworker
sw.description: A Seabee who fabricates, welds and erects steel structures, bridges and other metal work.
sw.training: Boot camp, then about 11 weeks of 'A' School in Gulfport, MS.

ut.title: Utilitiesman
ut.description: A Seabee who installs and maintains plumbing, heating, air conditioning, water and wastewater systems.
ut.training: Boot camp, then about 13 weeks of 'A' School at Sheppard AFB, TX.

at.title: Aviation Electronics Technician
at.description: Maintains and repairs aircraft electronics such as radar, navigation, communications and weapons systems.
at.training: Boot camp, then about 19 weeks of 'A' School in Pensacola, FL.

et.title: Electronics Technician
et.description: Maintains and repairs shipboard electronics like radars, communications gear and navigation systems.
et.training: Boot camp, then Apprentice Technical Training in Great Lakes, IL, followed by specialty training.

etv.title: Electronics Technician Navigation (Submarines)
etv.description: Operates and maintains a submarine's navigation and ship-control electronics and helps plot the boat's course.
etv.training: Boot camp, Basic Enlisted Submarine School, then 'A' School and pipeline training in Groton, CT.

fc.title: Fire Controlman
fc.description: Operates and maintains the radar, computer and weapons-control systems on surface warships, including Aegis (FCA).
fc.training: Boot camp, then about 31 weeks of Apprentice Technical Training and FC strand training in Great Lakes, IL.

ft.title: Fire Control Technician
ft.description: Maintains and operates the computers and electronics that control a submarine's torpedoes and missiles.
ft.training: Boot camp, Basic Enlisted Submarine School, then about 18 weeks of 'A' School and pipeline training in Groton, CT.

ic.title: Interior Communications Electrician
ic.description: Installs and repairs a ship's internal communication systems, from alarms and phones to entertainment and navigation gear.
ic.training: Boot camp, then about 21 weeks of technical and 'A' School training in Great Lakes, IL.

it.title: Information Systems Technician
it.description: Runs and secures shipboard and shore computer networks, communications circuits and IT systems.
it.training: Boot camp, then about 24 weeks of 'A' School in Pensacola, FL (Groton, CT for submarine ITs).

ite.title: Information Systems Technician Submarines - Electronic Warfare
ite.description: Submarine IT specialist who runs electronic warfare and signal-detection equipment.
ite.training: Basic Enlisted Submarine School and 'A' School in Groton, CT, then the electronic warfare pipeline.

itn.title: Information Systems Technician Submarines - Network
itn.description: Submarine IT specialist who manages and defends the boat's computer networks.
itn.training: Basic Enlisted Submarine School and 'A' School in Groton, CT, then the network pipeline.

itr.title: Information Systems Technician Submarines - Communications
itr.description: Submarine IT specialist who operates and maintains radio and communications systems.
itr.training: Basic Enlisted Submarine School and 'A' School in Groton, CT, then the communications pipeline.

mt.title: Missile Technician
mt.description: Maintains, tests and loads the ballistic missiles carried on Navy submarines.
mt.training: Boot camp, Basic Enlisted Submarine School and mechanical skills training in Groton, CT, then MT 'A' School.

rw.title: Robotics Warfare Specialist
rw.description: Operates and maintains robotic and autonomous systems, including their autonomy software, data and AI components.
rw.training: Conversion-only rating for current Sailors (E-4 to E-9) holding unmanned-systems NECs; not a direct-entry job.

dc.title: Damage Controlman
dc.description: Shipboard firefighter and emergency responder who handles fires, flooding and chemical, biological and radiological defense.
dc.training: Boot camp, then about 10 weeks of Basic Engineering Common Core and 'A' School in Great Lakes, IL.

ma.title: Master-at-Arms
ma.description: Navy police and security force: enforces laws, guards bases and ships, does antiterrorism work and handles military working dogs.
ma.training: Boot camp, then about 9 weeks of 'A' School in San Antonio, TX.

ad.title: Aviation Machinist's Mate
ad.description: Maintains and repairs aircraft jet engines, propellers and related mechanical systems.
ad.training: Boot camp, then a core 'A' School in Pensacola, FL, plus aircraft-specific strand training.

ae.title: Aviation Electrician's Mate
ae.description: Maintains aircraft electrical systems including power generation, lighting, instruments and flight controls.
ae.training: Boot camp, then about 13 weeks of 'A' School in Pensacola, FL.

am.title: Aviation Structural Mechanic
am.description: Repairs aircraft airframes, skins, hydraulics and landing gear.
am.training: Boot camp, then about 9 weeks of 'A' School in Pensacola, FL.

ame.title: Aviation Structural Mechanic - Safety Equipment
ame.description: Maintains aircraft ejection seats, oxygen systems and other life-saving equipment.
ame.training: Boot camp, then about 9 weeks of 'A' School in Pensacola, FL.

as.title: Aviation Support Equipment Technician
as.description: Maintains the ground support gear used to service aircraft, such as tow tractors, generators and air conditioners.
as.training: Boot camp, then about 17 weeks of 'A' School in Pensacola, FL.

bm.title: Boatswain's Mate
bm.description: Handles deck seamanship: mooring, anchoring, small boats, rigging, cargo handling and underway replenishment.
bm.training: Boot camp, then about 5 weeks of 'A' School in Great Lakes, IL.

em.title: Electrician's Mate
em.description: Operates and repairs a ship's electrical generators, power distribution, motors and lighting.
em.training: Boot camp, then Basic Engineering Common Core and electrical training in Great Lakes, IL.

en.title: Engineman
en.description: Maintains diesel engines, boats, refrigeration and auxiliary machinery on ships.
en.training: Boot camp, then about 14 weeks of Basic Engineering Common Core and 'A' School in Great Lakes, IL.

gm.title: Gunner's Mate
gm.description: Maintains and operates naval guns, missile launchers and small arms, and manages ammunition.
gm.training: Boot camp, then about 15 weeks of 'A' School in Great Lakes, IL.

gse.title: Gas Turbine Systems Technician - Electrical
gse.description: Maintains the electrical and electronic controls of the gas turbine engines that power many Navy ships.
gse.training: Boot camp, then Basic Engineering Common Core and 'A' School in Great Lakes, IL.

gsm.title: Gas Turbine Systems Technician - Mechanical
gsm.description: Operates and repairs the mechanical side of shipboard gas turbine engines and their auxiliaries.
gsm.training: Boot camp, then about 15 weeks of Basic Engineering Common Core and 'A' School in Great Lakes, IL.

ht.title: Hull Maintenance Technician
ht.description: Welds, cuts and repairs ship structures and plumbing, and helps with damage control.
ht.training: Boot camp, then Basic Engineering Common Core and 'A' School plus HT strand training in Great Lakes, IL.

mm.title: Machinist's Mate
mm.description: Operates and maintains ship propulsion plants, pumps, compressors, air conditioning and other machinery.
mm.training: Boot camp, then Basic Engineering Common Core and 'A' School in Great Lakes, IL.

mma.title: Machinist's Mate Auxiliary (Submarines)
mma.description: Maintains a submarine's auxiliary systems such as atmosphere control, hydraulics, refrigeration and air.
mma.training: Boot camp, Basic Enlisted Submarine School and Machinist's Mate 'A' School in Groton, CT.

mn.title: Mineman
mn.description: Assembles, tests and lays sea mines and operates mine-hunting sonar and equipment.
mn.training: Boot camp, then about 19 weeks of 'A' School in Point Loma, CA.

mr.title: Machinery Repairman
mr.description: Runs machine-shop tools like lathes and mills to make and repair replacement parts aboard ship.
mr.training: Boot camp, then about 18 weeks of Engineering Common Core and 'A' School in Great Lakes, IL.

pr.title: Aircrew Survival Equipmentman
pr.description: Packs parachutes and maintains flight gear, life rafts and survival equipment for aircrews.
pr.training: Boot camp, then about 12 weeks of core and strand 'A' School in Pensacola, FL.

tm.title: Torpedoman's Mate
tm.description: Maintains and handles torpedoes and other weapons and launch systems aboard submarines.
tm.training: Boot camp, Basic Enlisted Submarine School in Groton, CT, then advanced technical training.

1110.title: Surface Warfare Officer
1110.description: Leads Sailors aboard surface warships and works toward driving and commanding ships.
1110.training: OCS, Naval Academy or ROTC commission, then SWO basic training before reporting to a ship.

1810.title: Cryptologic Warfare Officer
1810.description: Leads signals intelligence, electronic warfare, cyber and space-related cryptologic operations.
1810.training: Officer Candidate School, then the 8-week Information Warfare Basic Course in Pensacola, FL.

1820.title: Communications Systems Warfare Officer
1820.description: Runs the Navy's command-and-control networks, communications and IT systems so commanders can share information securely (formerly Information Professional).
1820.training: Officer Candidate School in Newport, RI, then an Information Warfare training pipeline.

1830.title: Intelligence Officer
1830.description: Leads the analysis and briefing of intelligence about adversaries to support operational planning.
1830.training: Officer Candidate School, then a roughly five-month basic intelligence course in Dam Neck, VA.

1840.title: Cyber Warfare Engineer
1840.description: Officer with a technical background who develops cyber tools and capabilities for offensive and defensive operations.
1840.training: Officer Development School in Newport, RI, then assignment to a Navy Information Operations Command.

1880.title: Maritime Cyber Warfare Officer
1880.description: Leads offensive and defensive cyberspace operations to protect Navy networks and disrupt adversaries.

cti.title: Cryptologic Technician (Interpretive)
cti.description: Linguist who translates and analyzes foreign-language communications for intelligence.
cti.training: Boot camp, then language training at the Defense Language Institute, Monterey, CA (roughly 27-64 weeks).

ctm.title: Cryptologic Technician (Maintenance)
ctm.description: Installs and repairs the cryptologic and signals-intelligence computer and electronic systems.
ctm.training: Boot camp, then about 13 weeks of 'A' School in Pensacola, FL.

ctr.title: Cryptologic Technician (Collection)
ctr.description: Collects and analyzes foreign communications signals to produce intelligence.
ctr.training: Boot camp, then about 18 weeks of 'A' School in Pensacola, FL.

ctt.title: Cryptologic Technician (Technical)
ctt.description: Analyzes radar and other electronic signals and carries out electronic warfare.
ctt.training: Boot camp, then about 12 weeks of 'A' School in Pensacola, FL.

cwt.title: Cyber Warfare Technician
cwt.description: Conducts defensive and offensive cyber operations, analyzing networks and countering digital threats.
cwt.training: Boot camp, then about 23 weeks of 'A' School in Pensacola, FL.

is.title: Intelligence Specialist
is.description: Gathers, analyzes and briefs intelligence on enemy forces and threats to support operations.
is.training: Boot camp, then about 13 weeks of 'A' School in Dam Neck, VA.

os.title: Operations Specialist
os.description: Works in a ship's combat information center running radar, tracking contacts and helping coordinate tactical operations.
os.training: Boot camp, then about 10 weeks of 'A' School in Great Lakes, IL.

qm.title: Quartermaster
qm.description: Helps navigate surface ships by plotting courses, standing bridge watches and keeping charts and logs.
qm.training: Boot camp, then about 9 weeks of 'A' School in Great Lakes, IL.

stg.title: Sonar Technician (Surface)
stg.description: Operates and maintains surface-ship sonar to detect and track submarines and other underwater contacts.
stg.training: Boot camp, then about 10 weeks of 'A' School in San Diego, CA, plus an advanced operator course.

sts.title: Sonar Technician (Submarines)
sts.description: Operates and maintains a submarine's sonar systems to listen for and track contacts.
sts.training: Boot camp, Basic Enlisted Submarine School, then sonar 'A' School and pipeline training in Groton, CT.

2500.title: Judge Advocate General's Corps Officer
2500.description: Navy lawyer who prosecutes and defends courts-martial and advises on military, international and administrative law.
2500.training: Officer Development School, then a 10-week course at Naval Justice School, Newport, RI.

ln.title: Legalman
ln.description: Paralegal who supports Navy lawyers with courts-martial, legal assistance and administrative law cases.
ln.training: Boot camp, then an 11-week course at Naval Justice School, Newport, RI.

2100.title: Physician (Medical Corps)
2100.description: Doctor who provides medical and surgical care to service members in hospitals, on ships and with operational units.
2100.training: Officer Development School after medical school, then internship/residency as required.

2200.title: Dentist (Dental Corps)
2200.description: Provides dental care to Sailors and Marines in clinics, on ships and with field units.
2200.training: Officer Development School after dental school.

2300-aerospace-operational-physiologist.title: Aerospace & Operational Physiologist
2300-aerospace-operational-physiologist.description: Medical Service Corps officer who trains aircrew on the physical stresses of flight and survival.
2300-aerospace-operational-physiologist.training: Officer Development School, then aviation and physiology training.

2300.title: Aerospace Experimental Psychologist
2300.description: Medical Service Corps scientist who studies human performance in aviation and helps design aircraft systems and training.
2300.training: Officer Development School, then flight and specialty training.

2300-audiologist.title: Audiologist
2300-audiologist.description: Medical Service Corps officer who tests hearing, treats hearing problems and runs hearing conservation programs.
2300-audiologist.training: Officer Development School in Newport, RI.

2300-clinical-psychologist.title: Clinical Psychologist
2300-clinical-psychologist.description: Provides mental health assessment and therapy for service members and families.
2300-clinical-psychologist.training: Officer Development School; some enter through Navy-funded graduate or internship programs.

2300-environmental-health-officer.title: Environmental Health Officer
2300-environmental-health-officer.description: Protects personnel from environmental and disease hazards through inspections and health surveillance.
2300-environmental-health-officer.training: Officer Development School in Newport, RI.

2300-health-care-administrator.title: Health Care Administrator
2300-health-care-administrator.description: Manages the business side of Navy medicine, such as finance, operations and information systems.
2300-health-care-administrator.training: Officer Development School in Newport, RI.

2300-industrial-hygiene-officer.title: Industrial Hygiene Officer
2300-industrial-hygiene-officer.description: Finds and controls workplace hazards like noise, chemicals and radiation to keep personnel safe.
2300-industrial-hygiene-officer.training: Officer Development School in Newport, RI.

2300-medical-technologist.title: Medical Technologist
2300-medical-technologist.description: Runs clinical laboratories and blood banks that support diagnosis and treatment.
2300-medical-technologist.training: Officer Development School in Newport, RI.

2300-occupational-therapist.title: Occupational Therapist
2300-occupational-therapist.description: Helps patients regain everyday function after injury or illness through rehabilitation therapy.
2300-occupational-therapist.training: Officer Development School in Newport, RI.

2300-optometrist.title: Optometrist
2300-optometrist.description: Provides eye exams, vision care and treatment of eye conditions.
2300-optometrist.training: Officer Development School in Newport, RI.

2300-pharmacist.title: Pharmacist
2300-pharmacist.description: Manages pharmacy services and medication safety at Navy treatment facilities.
2300-pharmacist.training: Officer Development School in Newport, RI.

2300-physical-therapist.title: Physical Therapist
2300-physical-therapist.description: Treats musculoskeletal injuries and helps service members recover strength and mobility.
2300-physical-therapist.training: Officer Development School in Newport, RI.

2300-physician-assistant.title: Physician Assistant
2300-physician-assistant.description: Diagnoses and treats patients as a licensed provider working alongside Navy physicians.
2300-physician-assistant.training: Officer Development School in Newport, RI.

2300-podiatrist.title: Podiatrist
2300-podiatrist.description: Diagnoses and treats foot and ankle conditions.
2300-podiatrist.training: Officer Development School in Newport, RI.

2300-radiation-health-officer.title: Radiation Health Officer
2300-radiation-health-officer.description: Oversees radiation safety programs, especially for nuclear-powered ships and medical facilities.
2300-radiation-health-officer.training: Officer Development School, then radiation health training.

2300-registered-dietitian.title: Registered Dietitian
2300-registered-dietitian.description: Medical Service Corps officer who manages nutrition care and food service programs.
2300-registered-dietitian.training: Officer Development School in Newport, RI.

2300-research-biochemist-forensic-toxico.title: Research Biochemist & Forensic Toxicologist
2300-research-biochemist-forensic-toxico.description: Scientist who does lab research and forensic drug testing that supports service member health and safety.

2300-research-physiologist.title: Research Physiologist
2300-research-physiologist.description: Studies how the body responds to extreme military environments such as diving, altitude and heat.
2300-research-physiologist.training: Officer Development School in Newport, RI.

2300-research-psychologist.title: Research Psychologist
2300-research-psychologist.description: Researches human behavior and performance to improve training, selection and readiness.
2300-research-psychologist.training: Officer Development School in Newport, RI.

2300-social-worker.title: Social Worker
2300-social-worker.description: Provides counseling, family support and crisis intervention for Sailors, Marines and families.
2300-social-worker.training: Officer Development School in Newport, RI.

2900.title: Navy Nurse (Nurse Corps)
2900.description: Registered nurse officer who provides and leads patient care in hospitals, clinics, ships and deployed units.
2900.training: Officer Development School in Newport, RI (some ROTC-commissioned nurses are exempt).

hm.title: Hospital Corpsman
hm.description: Gives medical care to Sailors, Marines and their families, in clinics and hospitals, on ships and in the field.
hm.training: Boot camp, then about 19 weeks of Hospital Corps 'A' School in San Antonio, TX; Field Medical training for Marine Corps units.

hm-hospital-corpsman-advanced-technical-.title: Hospital Corpsman - Advanced Technical Field (HM-ATF)
hm-hospital-corpsman-advanced-technical-.description: Hospital Corpsmen trained as special operations, reconnaissance or diving medics who treat casualties in combat and austere settings.
hm-hospital-corpsman-advanced-technical-.training: Boot camp, Hospital Corps 'A' School (19 weeks), then one of three long advanced pipelines such as the Special Operations Independent Duty Corpsman course.

hm-mortician.title: Mortician
hm-mortician.description: Hospital Corpsman specialty that recovers, prepares and returns the remains of fallen service members with dignity.
hm-mortician.training: Boot camp, then Hospital Corps 'A' School (19 weeks) in San Antonio, TX.

4100.title: Navy Chaplain (Chaplain Corps)
4100.description: Clergy officer who leads religious services and provides counseling and spiritual care to service members of all faiths.
4100.training: Officer Development School, then a 7-week Naval Chaplaincy School course in Newport, RI.

rp.title: Religious Program Specialist
rp.description: Assists chaplains with religious programs and administration, and serves as the chaplain's security.
rp.training: Boot camp, then about 8 weeks of 'A' School at the Naval Chaplaincy School, Newport, RI.

naval-reactors-engineer.title: Naval Reactors Engineer
naval-reactors-engineer.description: Engineer officer at Naval Reactors headquarters who helps design, oversee and regulate the Navy's nuclear propulsion plants.
naval-reactors-engineer.training: Officer Development School, then specialized nuclear engineering training.

nuclear-power-school-instructor.title: Nuclear Power School Instructor
nuclear-power-school-instructor.description: Officer who teaches nuclear engineering and reactor theory at Nuclear Power School.
nuclear-power-school-instructor.training: Officer Development School, then instructor preparation.

nuclear-power-training-unit-instructor.title: Nuclear Power Training Unit Instructor
nuclear-power-training-unit-instructor.description: Officer who trains Sailors and officers to operate nuclear reactor prototypes.
nuclear-power-training-unit-instructor.training: Officer Development School, Nuclear Power School, then prototype training.

nuclear-surface-warfare-officer.title: Nuclear Surface Warfare Officer
nuclear-surface-warfare-officer.description: Surface Warfare Officer who also qualifies to run the nuclear plants of aircraft carriers.
nuclear-surface-warfare-officer.training: OCS, Nuclear Power School and prototype training, plus SWO training.

1120.title: Submarine Officer
1120.description: Leads Sailors aboard nuclear-powered submarines and qualifies to operate their reactors and weapons.
1120.training: OCS (or Academy/ROTC), Nuclear Power School, prototype training and the Submarine Officer Basic Course.

1440.title: Engineering Duty Officer
1440.description: Designs, builds, buys and maintains Navy ships, submarines and combat systems.
1440.training: Engineering Duty Officer qualification program and acquisition courses after initial officer training.

1800.title: Meteorology & Oceanography Officer (METOC)
1800.description: Forecasts weather and ocean conditions and advises commanders on how the environment affects operations.
1800.training: Officer Candidate School, then Basic Oceanography Accession Training in Gulfport, MS.

2300-entomologist.title: Entomologist
2300-entomologist.description: Medical Service Corps scientist who controls disease-carrying insects and pests that threaten personnel.
2300-entomologist.training: Officer Development School in Newport, RI.

2300-microbiologist.title: Microbiologist
2300-microbiologist.description: Medical Service Corps scientist who studies infectious diseases and supports labs, diagnostics and biodefense.
2300-microbiologist.training: Officer Development School in Newport, RI.

ag.title: Aerographer's Mate
ag.description: Observes, records and forecasts weather and ocean conditions for the fleet.
ag.training: Boot camp, then about 19 weeks of 'A' School at Keesler AFB, MS.

emn.title: Electrician's Mate (Nuclear)
emn.description: Operates and maintains the electrical systems of nuclear reactor plants on submarines and carriers.
emn.training: Boot camp, about six months of 'A' School in Charleston, SC, then Nuclear Power School and prototype training.

etn.title: Electronics Technician (Nuclear)
etn.description: Operates and maintains the reactor control and instrumentation electronics in nuclear propulsion plants.
etn.training: Boot camp, about six months of 'A' School in Charleston, SC, then Nuclear Power School and prototype training.

mmn.title: Machinist's Mate (Nuclear)
mmn.description: Operates and maintains steam, propulsion and reactor-support mechanical systems in nuclear plants.
mmn.training: Boot camp, about six months of 'A' School in Charleston, SC, then Nuclear Power School and prototype training.

1130.title: Special Warfare Officer (SEAL)
1130.description: Leads Navy SEAL platoons and teams in special operations missions.
1130.training: Officer commission, then BUD/S, parachute school and SEAL Qualification Training.

1140.title: Explosive Ordnance Disposal Officer
1140.description: Leads Navy EOD teams that clear explosives, mines and IEDs and support diving and salvage missions.
1140.training: Officer commission, then the EOD and dive training pipeline.

airr.title: Aircrew Rescue Swimmer
airr.description: A demanding aircrew program whose members jump from helicopters to rescue people at sea and also run helicopter mission systems; graduates serve in an aircrew rating such as AWS or AWR.
airr.training: Boot camp, prep course, Aircrew Candidate School and Rescue Swimmer School in Pensacola, FL, then aircrew 'A' School; about two years in total.

eod.title: Explosive Ordnance Disposal Technician
eod.description: The Navy's bomb squad: finds and disarms explosives, mines and IEDs on land and underwater, often diving or parachuting in.
eod.training: Boot camp, EOD Preparatory Course in Great Lakes, IL, then dive school and EOD school, plus follow-on tactical training.

nd.title: Navy Diver
nd.description: Does underwater salvage, ship repair, search and recovery, and submarine rescue missions.
nd.training: Boot camp, a 7-week Diver Preparation Course in Great Lakes, IL, then about 15 weeks of Second Class Dive School in Panama City, FL.

sb.title: Special Warfare Boat Operator (SWCC)
sb.description: Operates high-speed combat craft to insert special operations forces and conduct maritime raids and reconnaissance.
sb.training: Boot camp, then the SWCC pipeline (assessment plus Alpha, Bravo and Charlie phases), SERE and jump school.

so.title: Special Warfare Operator (Navy SEAL)
so.description: Elite special operations commando who carries out raids, reconnaissance and counterterrorism missions at sea, in the air and on land.
so.training: Boot camp, then about 56 weeks of initial training including BUD/S, parachute school and SEAL Qualification Training.

11bx.title: Bomber Pilot
11bx.description: Flies long-range bombers such as the B-52, B-1 and B-2 to strike targets anywhere in the world.

11ex.title: Experimental Test Pilot
11ex.description: Experienced pilot who flies new and modified aircraft to test their performance, safety and weapons before they enter service.

11fx.title: Fighter Pilot
11fx.description: Flies fighter and attack jets such as the F-35, F-22, F-15, F-16 and A-10 in air-to-air and air-to-ground combat.

11gx.title: Generalist Pilot
11gx.description: Flies aircraft that do not fit the other pilot categories, such as VIP transport and support aircraft.

11hx.title: Rescue Pilot
11hx.description: Flies rescue helicopters and aircraft such as the HH-60W and HC-130J to recover isolated or injured personnel.

11mx.title: Mobility Pilot
11mx.description: Flies cargo and tanker aircraft such as the C-17, C-130 and KC-46 to move troops and equipment and refuel other aircraft.

11rx.title: Reconnaissance/Surveillance/Electronic Warfare Pilot
11rx.description: Flies aircraft such as the U-2 and RC-135 that gather intelligence or jam enemy systems.

11sx.title: Special Operations Pilot
11sx.description: Flies special operations aircraft such as the AC-130J, MC-130J and CV-22, often at night and at low altitude.

11ux.title: Remotely Piloted Aircraft Pilot
11ux.description: Flies drones such as the MQ-9 Reaper from ground control stations for surveillance and strike missions.

12x.title: Combat Systems Officer
12x.description: Aircrew officer who handles navigation, weapons employment and electronic warfare on bombers, fighters, gunships and other aircraft.

13bx.title: Air Battle Manager
13bx.description: Directs the air battle from airborne or ground radar platforms, controlling fighters and managing the airspace.

13hx.title: Aerospace Physiologist
13hx.description: Leads programs that protect aircrew from the physical stresses of flight, such as hypoxia, G-forces and disorientation.

15wx.title: Weather and Environmental Sciences Officer
15wx.description: Leads weather forecasting teams and advises commanders on how weather and space conditions will affect operations.

1a1x2.title: Mobility Force Aviator
1a1x2.description: Flies as enlisted aircrew on airlift and tanker aircraft, combining the old loadmaster, flight engineer and boom operator roles. Depending on the jet, they load cargo, run aircraft systems or refuel other planes in flight.

1a1x3.title: Special Missions Aviator
1a1x3.description: Enlisted aircrew on special operations, rescue and gunship aircraft who handle everything from preflight checks and cargo loading to operating defensive weapons in the air.
1a1x3.training: Tech school: Lackland AFB, TX, 27 days

1a1x4.title: Multi-Domain Operations Aviator
1a1x4.description: Operates radar, sensor and communications systems on manned or unmanned aircraft to track the battlespace, identify targets and pass critical information to commanders.
1a1x4.training: Tech school: Lackland AFB, TX, 27 days

1a1x8.title: Executive Mission Aviator
1a1x8.description: Crews the aircraft that carry senior leaders, including the presidential fleet, serving as flight attendants, flight engineers or communications operators who keep VIP missions running smoothly.

1a3x1.title: Airborne Mission Systems Specialist
1a3x1.description: Flies aboard command-and-control and surveillance aircraft, operating and troubleshooting the radios, data links and mission electronics in flight.
1a3x1.training: Tech school: Lackland AFB, TX, 33 days

1c1x1.title: Air Traffic Control
1c1x1.description: Guides aircraft safely on the ground and through the sky using radar, radios and visual control from towers and radar facilities.
1c1x1.training: Tech school: Keesler AFB, MS, 72 days

1c3x1.title: All-Domain Command and Control Operations
1c3x1.description: Works in command posts and operations centers, tracking forces and relaying orders and emergency information so leaders can direct missions in real time.
1c3x1.training: Tech school: Keesler AFB, MS, 30 days

1c5x1.title: Battle Management Operations
1c5x1.description: Uses radar and data links on the ground or aboard aircraft to watch the airspace, detect threats and direct friendly aircraft during operations.
1c5x1.training: Tech school: Keesler AFB, MS, 30 days

1c7x1.title: Airfield Management
1c7x1.description: Keeps the airfield safe and running by inspecting runways, managing flight plans and coordinating aircraft movements with base agencies.
1c7x1.training: Tech school: Keesler AFB, MS, 30 days

1h0x1.title: Aerospace Physiology
1h0x1.description: Teaches aircrew how the body reacts to altitude, G-forces and spatial disorientation, and runs altitude chambers and other training devices.
1h0x1.training: Tech school: Wright Patterson AFB, OH, 42 days

1u0x1.title: Remotely Piloted Aircraft (RPA) Sensor Operator
1u0x1.description: Operates the cameras and sensors on drones such as the MQ-9, working beside the RPA pilot to find, track and watch targets.
1u0x1.training: Tech school: Lackland AFB, TX; Randolph AFB TX, 31 days

1w0x1.title: Weather
1w0x1.description: Observes and forecasts weather and space weather conditions so commanders and aircrews can plan safe and effective missions.
1w0x1.training: Tech school: Keesler AFB, MS (335th TRS), 133 days

2a2x1.title: MH-139 Electrical, Environmental and Avionics Technician
2a2x1.description: Maintains the electrical, environmental and avionics systems on the MH-139 Grey Wolf helicopter that guards ICBM fields and carries VIPs.
2a2x1.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB TX, 117 days

2a3x4.title: Fighter Aircraft Integrated Avionics
2a3x4.description: Tests, troubleshoots and repairs the navigation, radar, weapons-control and communication electronics on fighters like the F-15, F-16 and A-10.
2a3x4.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 109 - 126 days

2a9x4.title: Heavy Aircraft Integrated Avionics
2a9x4.description: Maintains the communication, navigation, flight-control, radar and electronic-warfare systems on bombers, tankers, airlifters and special-mission aircraft.

14nx.title: Intelligence Officer
14nx.description: Leads intelligence teams and briefs commanders on enemy capabilities and intentions to shape missions.

17dx.title: Warfighter Communications Operations Officer
17dx.description: Leads the units that build and run Air Force communications, networks and IT systems.

17sx.title: Cyberspace Effects Operations Officer
17sx.description: Leads offensive and defensive cyber operations crews that protect networks and create effects against adversaries.

17w.title: Warfighter Communications & IT Systems Operations Warrant Officer
17w.description: Technical expert and adviser who plans, deploys and secures Air Force communication and IT systems and mentors cyber and IT Airmen.
17w.training: Warrant Officer Training School at Maxwell AFB, AL

17y.title: Cyber Effects & Warfare Operations Warrant Officer
17y.description: Technical expert and adviser on offensive and defensive cyber operations who integrates cyber capabilities into combat missions and trains cyber operators.
17y.training: Warrant Officer Training School at Maxwell AFB, AL

1a8x1.title: Airborne Cryptologic Language Analyst
1a8x1.description: Flies on reconnaissance aircraft as a linguist, listening to and translating foreign communications to give crews and commanders real-time warning and intelligence.
1a8x1.training: Training: JBSA-Lackland, TX; Defense Language Institute, Monterey, CA; Goodfellow AFB, TX; 224-459 days

1a8x2.title: Airborne Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance (ISR) Operator
1a8x2.description: Flies on ISR aircraft collecting and analyzing signals and other intelligence, then shares what they find with forces on the ground and in the air.
1a8x2.training: Training: JBSA-Lackland, TX and Goodfellow AFB, TX; 83 days

1b4x1.title: Cyber Warfare Operations
1b4x1.description: Conducts offensive and defensive operations in cyberspace, hunting threats on networks and creating effects against adversary systems.
1b4x1.training: Tech school: Keesler AFB, MS (length not stated)

1c6x1.title: Space Systems Operations
1c6x1.description: Operates space-related systems such as satellite command, missile warning and space surveillance equipment and reports on activity in space.
1c6x1.training: Tech school: Vandenberg SFB, CA, 51-100 days

1d7x1.title: Information Technology Systems (Cyber Defense Operations)
1d7x1.description: Builds, runs and secures the Air Force's computer networks, servers and user systems, from network infrastructure to help-desk support and knowledge management.
1d7x1.training: Tech school: Keesler AFB, MS (length varies by specialty)

1d7x4.title: Data Engineering
1d7x4.description: Newer cyber specialty focused on collecting, organizing and managing data so it can be analyzed and used for decisions.

1d7x5.title: Cybersecurity
1d7x5.description: Newer cyber specialty focused on protecting Air Force networks and mission systems from attack by assessing risk and defending key systems.

1n0x1.title: All Source Intelligence Analyst
1n0x1.description: Pulls together intelligence from many sources to brief aircrews and commanders on enemy forces, threats and the overall situation.
1n0x1.training: Tech school: Goodfellow AFB, TX, 90.5 days

1n1x1.title: Geospatial Intelligence
1n1x1.description: Studies satellite and aerial imagery and other geographic data to locate targets, assess damage and map out enemy activity.
1n1x1.training: Tech school: Goodfellow AFB, TX, 110-112 days

1n2x1.title: Signals Intelligence Analyst
1n2x1.description: Analyzes intercepted communications and electronic signals to figure out where adversaries are and what they are doing.
1n2x1.training: Tech school: Goodfellow AFB, TX, 74-84 days

1n3x1.title: Cryptologic Language Analyst
1n3x1.description: Uses foreign-language skills to translate and analyze intercepted communications on the ground, turning them into usable intelligence.
1n3x1.training: Tech school: Goodfellow AFB, TX, 110 days (language training is separate)

1n4x1.title: Cyber Intelligence Analyst
1n4x1.description: Analyzes adversary networks and digital activity to support cyber operations and spot cyber threats before they hit.
1n4x1.training: Tech school: Goodfellow AFB, TX or Corry Station, FL, 135 days

1n4x2.title: Cryptologic Analyst and Reporter
1n4x2.description: Turns raw signals intelligence into timely reports and warnings for commanders and national decision makers.
1n4x2.training: Tech school: Goodfellow AFB, TX, 110 days

9s100.title: Scientific Applications Specialist
9s100.description: Uses science and technical sensors to detect and analyze nuclear explosions and other weapons activity around the world, supporting treaty monitoring.
9s100.training: Tech school: Goodfellow AFB, TX, 90 days

41ax.title: Health Services Administrator
41ax.description: Manages the business and operations of military hospitals and clinics, from budgets to staffing.

42bx.title: Physical Therapist
42bx.description: Diagnoses and treats injuries and movement problems to get Airmen back to full duty.

42ex.title: Optometrist
42ex.description: Provides eye exams and vision care, including the special vision needs of aircrew.

42fx.title: Podiatric Surgeon
42fx.description: Diagnoses and surgically treats foot and ankle conditions.

42gx.title: Physician Assistant
42gx.description: Examines, diagnoses and treats patients as part of a physician-led medical team.

42nx.title: Audiologist
42nx.description: Tests and protects hearing and treats hearing problems, a big deal around loud aircraft.

42px.title: Clinical Psychologist
42px.description: Provides psychological assessment and therapy and supports the mental readiness of Airmen.

42sx.title: Clinical Social Worker
42sx.description: Provides counseling and connects Airmen and families with support services.

42tx.title: Occupational Therapist
42tx.description: Helps patients regain the skills needed for daily life and duty after injury or illness.

43bx.title: Biomedical Scientist
43bx.description: Applies scientific research and expertise to medical and operational health problems.

43dx.title: Dietitian
43dx.description: Manages nutrition care and food service programs and counsels patients on diet.

43ex.title: Bioenvironmental Engineer
43ex.description: Leads programs that identify and control environmental and workplace health hazards.

43hx.title: Public Health Officer
43hx.description: Leads disease prevention, outbreak investigation and community health programs.

43mx.title: Medical Entomologist
43mx.description: Studies insects and other pests that spread disease and plans ways to protect forces from them.

43px.title: Pharmacist
43px.description: Dispenses medications, advises doctors and patients on drugs and manages pharmacy operations.

43tx.title: Biomedical Laboratory Officer
43tx.description: Oversees clinical laboratories that run diagnostic tests and manage blood supplies.

44bx.title: Preventive Medicine Physician
44bx.description: Physician focused on preventing disease and injury across whole populations of Airmen.

44dx.title: Pathologist
44dx.description: Physician who diagnoses disease by examining tissue, blood and other samples.

44ex.title: Emergency Services Physician
44ex.description: Physician who treats urgent and life-threatening illnesses and injuries in emergency departments.

44fx.title: Family Physician
44fx.description: Physician who provides primary care for patients of all ages.

44gx.title: General Practice Physician
44gx.description: Physician who examines, diagnoses and treats a wide range of everyday medical problems.

44hx.title: Nuclear Medicine Physician
44hx.description: Physician who uses small amounts of radioactive material to diagnose and treat disease.

44jx.title: Medical Geneticist and Genomicist
44jx.description: Physician who diagnoses and manages genetic conditions and applies genomics to patient care.

44kx.title: Pediatrician
44kx.description: Physician who cares for infants, children and teens of military families.

44mx.title: Internal Medicine Physician
44mx.description: Physician who diagnoses and manages complex adult illnesses.

44nx.title: Neurologist
44nx.description: Physician who treats disorders of the brain, spine and nerves.

44px.title: Psychiatrist
44px.description: Physician who diagnoses and treats mental health conditions, including with medication.

44rx.title: Diagnostic Radiologist
44rx.description: Physician who reads X-rays, CT, MRI and other images to diagnose disease and injury.

44sx.title: Dermatologist
44sx.description: Physician who treats skin, hair and nail conditions.

44tx.title: Radiation Oncologist
44tx.description: Physician who treats cancer with radiation therapy.

44ux.title: Occupational Medicine Physician
44ux.description: Physician who prevents and treats work-related illness and injury.

44yx.title: Critical Care Medicine Physician
44yx.description: Physician who cares for the sickest patients in intensive care units.

44zx.title: Allergist and Immunologist
44zx.description: Physician who diagnoses and treats allergies, asthma and immune system disorders.

45ax.title: Anesthesiologist
45ax.description: Physician who provides anesthesia and pain control during surgery and procedures.

45bx.title: Orthopedic Surgeon
45bx.description: Surgeon who repairs bones, joints, muscles and ligaments.

45ex.title: Ophthalmologist
45ex.description: Physician and surgeon who treats eye diseases and performs eye surgery.

45gx.title: Obstetrician/Gynecologist (OB/GYN)
45gx.description: Physician who provides women's health care, delivers babies and performs gynecologic surgery.

45nx.title: Otolaryngologist - Head and Neck Surgeon
45nx.description: Ear, nose and throat specialist who treats and operates on head and neck conditions.

45sx.title: Surgeon
45sx.description: Performs general and trauma surgery in military hospitals and deployed settings.

45ux.title: Urologist
45ux.description: Physician and surgeon who treats urinary tract and male reproductive conditions.

46ax.title: Nursing Administrator
46ax.description: Leads nursing services and nursing staff across a medical facility.

46fx.title: Flight Nurse
46fx.description: Cares for patients in the air during aeromedical evacuation flights.

46nx.title: Clinical Nurse
46nx.description: Registered nurse who provides direct patient care in hospitals and clinics.

46nxe.title: Critical Care Nurse
46nxe.description: Registered nurse who cares for critically ill patients in intensive care settings.

46nxf.title: Neonatal Intensive Care Nurse
46nxf.description: Registered nurse who cares for premature and seriously ill newborns.

46nxg.title: Obstetrical Nurse
46nxg.description: Registered nurse who cares for mothers and babies during pregnancy, labor and delivery.

46nxj.title: Emergency/Trauma Nurse
46nxj.description: Registered nurse who treats patients with urgent injuries and illnesses in emergency departments.

46px.title: Mental Health Nurse
46px.description: Registered nurse who cares for patients with mental health conditions.

46sx.title: Operating Room Nurse
46sx.description: Registered nurse who supports surgical teams before, during and after operations.

46yxa.title: Women's Healthcare Nurse Practitioner
46yxa.description: Advanced practice nurse who provides gynecologic and reproductive health care.

46yxb.title: Pediatric Nurse Practitioner
46yxb.description: Advanced practice nurse who provides primary care for children.

46yxg.title: Certified Nurse Midwife
46yxg.description: Advanced practice nurse who provides prenatal care and delivers babies.

46yxh.title: Family Nurse Practitioner
46yxh.description: Advanced practice nurse who diagnoses and treats patients of all ages in primary care.

46yxm.title: Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist
46yxm.description: Advanced practice nurse who gives anesthesia for surgery and procedures.

46yxp.title: Adult Psychiatric and Mental Health Nurse Practitioner
46yxp.description: Advanced practice nurse who diagnoses and treats adult mental health conditions.

47bx.title: Orthodontist
47bx.description: Dentist who straightens teeth and corrects bite problems.

47dx.title: Oral and Maxillofacial Pathologist
47dx.description: Dental specialist who diagnoses diseases of the mouth, jaw and face.

47ex.title: Endodontist
47ex.description: Dentist who specializes in root canals and treating the inside of teeth.

47gx.title: Dentist
47gx.description: Provides general dental care to keep Airmen dentally ready to deploy.

47hx.title: Periodontist
47hx.description: Dentist who treats gum disease and places dental implants.

47kx.title: Pediatric Dentist
47kx.description: Dentist who provides dental care for children.

47px.title: Prosthodontist
47px.description: Dentist who restores and replaces teeth with crowns, bridges, dentures and implants.

47sx.title: Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeon
47sx.description: Surgeon who operates on the mouth, jaws and face, including trauma repair.

48ax.title: Aerospace Medicine Specialist/Flight Surgeon
48ax.description: Physician specialist who keeps aircrew and special operators medically fit to fly and fight.

48ox.title: Aeromedical Physician
48ox.description: Physician trained in flight medicine who cares for aircrew and advises on flying fitness.

4a0x1.title: Health Services Management
4a0x1.description: Handles the business side of military medicine, including patient records, appointments, admissions and medical administration.
4a0x1.training: Tech school: Ft Sam Houston, TX, 36 days

4a1x1.title: Medical Materiel
4a1x1.description: Orders, stores and tracks medical supplies and equipment so clinics and hospitals always have what they need.
4a1x1.training: Tech school: Ft. Sam Houston, TX, 24 days

4c0x1.title: Mental Health Service
4c0x1.description: Assists psychologists and psychiatrists with patient screening, counseling support and substance-abuse prevention programs.
4c0x1.training: Tech school: Ft. Sam Houston, TX, 66 days

4d0x1.title: Diet Therapy
4d0x1.description: Helps plan and prepare therapeutic meals and supports nutrition counseling for patients and Airmen.
4d0x1.training: Tech school: Ft. Sam Houston, TX, 33 days

4e0x1.title: Public Health
4e0x1.description: Tracks and prevents disease, inspects food and facilities, and monitors the health of Airmen at home and deployed.
4e0x1.training: Tech school: Wright Patterson AFB, OH, 47 days

4h0x1.title: Respiratory Care Practitioner
4h0x1.description: Treats patients with breathing problems, running ventilators and other respiratory equipment in hospitals and critical-care transport.
4h0x1.training: Tech school: Phase I: Ft Sam Houston, TX. Phase II: Designated Medical Facility, 240 days

4j0x2.title: Physical Medicine
4j0x2.description: Works with physical and occupational therapists to help patients recover from injuries through exercise and rehabilitation treatments.
4j0x2.training: Tech school: Ft. Sam Houston, TX, 81 days

4n0x1.title: Aerospace Medical Service
4n0x1.description: Serves as the Air Force's medical technician, providing patient care in clinics, hospitals, ambulances and aeromedical evacuation flights.
4n0x1.training: Tech school: Ft Sam Houston, TX Designated Medical Facility, 98 days

4n1x1.title: Surgical Technologist
4n1x1.description: Prepares operating rooms and instruments and assists surgeons during procedures.
4n1x1.training: Tech school: Ft. Sam Houston, TX, Designated Medical Facility, 32 - 46 days

4p0x1.title: Pharmacy Technician
4p0x1.description: Prepares and dispenses medications and helps pharmacists manage drug inventories and patient prescriptions.
4p0x1.training: Tech school: Ft. Sam Houston, TX, 110 days

4r0x1.title: Diagnostic Imaging
4r0x1.description: Takes X-rays, ultrasounds, CT and MRI scans that doctors use to diagnose injuries and illnesses.
4r0x1.training: Tech school: Ft Sam Houston, TX, 340 - 450 days

4t0x1.title: Medical Laboratory
4t0x1.description: Runs lab tests on blood and other samples and manages blood banking to help diagnose and treat patients.
4t0x1.training: Tech school: Ft. Sam Houston, TX Designated Medical Facility, 268 days

4t0x2.title: Histopathology
4t0x2.description: Prepares tissue samples on slides so pathologists can examine them for diseases such as cancer.
4t0x2.training: Tech school: Ft. Sam Houston, TX, 180 days

4v0x1.title: Ophthalmic (Optometry)
4v0x1.description: Assists eye doctors with vision exams, eye testing and fitting glasses and protective eyewear.
4v0x1.training: Tech school: Ft. Sam Houston, TX, 53 days

4y0x1.title: Dental Assistant
4y0x1.description: Assists dentists during exams and procedures, takes dental X-rays and helps with preventive care.
4y0x1.training: Tech school: Ft Sam Houston, TX, 48 days

4y0x2.title: Dental Laboratory
4y0x2.description: Builds crowns, dentures, bridges and other dental appliances prescribed by dentists.
4y0x2.training: Tech school: Ft Sam Houston, TX, 130 days

1s0x1.title: Safety
1s0x1.description: Inspects workplaces, investigates mishaps and runs safety programs to prevent injuries and protect equipment.
1s0x1.training: Tech school: Lackland AFB, TX, 35 days

31px.title: Security Forces Officer
31px.description: Leads security forces units that defend bases, protect nuclear assets and enforce law.

3e7x1.title: Fire Protection
3e7x1.description: Fights structural and aircraft fires, performs rescues and responds to emergencies and hazardous materials incidents on base.
3e7x1.training: Tech school: Goodfellow AFB, TX, 68 days

3e9x1.title: Emergency Management
3e9x1.description: Plans for and responds to disasters and chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear threats, and trains Airmen to survive them.
3e9x1.training: Tech school: Ft. Leonard Wood, MO, 74 days

3p0x1.title: Security Forces
3p0x1.description: The Air Force's military police, guarding bases, aircraft and nuclear weapons, enforcing law and defending air bases when deployed.
3p0x1.training: Tech school: Lackland AFB, TX, 65 days

4b0x1.title: Bioenvironmental Engineering
4b0x1.description: Checks air, water and workplaces for hazards such as chemicals, radiation and noise to protect the health of Airmen.

51jx.title: Judge Advocate (JAG)
51jx.description: Air Force attorney who prosecutes or defends cases and advises commanders on military, international and operational law.

5j0x1.title: Paralegal
5j0x1.description: Supports Air Force attorneys by researching law, preparing legal documents and helping with military justice cases.
5j0x1.training: Tech school: Maxwell AFB, AL, 66 days

71sx.title: Special Investigations Officer (OSI)
71sx.description: Federal agent with the Office of Special Investigations who investigates serious crimes, fraud and threats from foreign intelligence and terrorism.

13mx.title: Airfield Operations Officer
13mx.description: Leads air traffic control and airfield management teams to keep flight operations safe and efficient.

14fx.title: Information Operations Officer
14fx.description: Plans operations that influence adversary decision-making and protect friendly information.

16gx.title: Air Force Operations Staff Officer
16gx.description: Experienced officer who develops Air Force and joint plans, programs and policies at headquarters staffs.

16rx.title: Planning and Programming Officer
16rx.description: Builds long-range plans and budgets that decide how the Air Force spends resources.

1c0x2.title: Aviation Resource Management
1c0x2.description: Tracks aircrew flying hours, training and qualifications so pilots and crews stay current and legal to fly.
1c0x2.training: Tech school: Keesler AFB, MS, 26 days

1p0x1.title: Aircrew Flight Equipment
1p0x1.description: Inspects and maintains the parachutes, helmets, oxygen masks, survival kits and night-vision gear aircrews depend on.
1p0x1.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 56 days

21rx.title: Logistics Readiness Officer
21rx.description: Leads supply, fuels, transportation and deployment teams that move and sustain Air Force forces.

2f0x1.title: Fuels Management
2f0x1.description: Stores, tests and delivers the jet fuel and other fuels that keep aircraft and vehicles running.
2f0x1.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 42 days

2g0x1.title: Logistics Plans
2g0x1.description: Plans how people and equipment deploy, making sure units get to the fight with everything they need.
2g0x1.training: Tech school: Lackland AFB, TX, 27 days

2r2x1.title: Maintenance Management
2r2x1.description: Schedules aircraft maintenance, tracks maintenance data and analyzes trends to keep fleets ready to fly.
2r2x1.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 63 days

2s0x1.title: Materiel Management
2s0x1.description: Orders, stores and issues the parts and supplies the Air Force uses, keeping inventories accurate.
2s0x1.training: Tech school: Lackland AFB, TX, 33 days

2t0x1.title: Traffic Management
2t0x1.description: Arranges the shipment of cargo and personal property and manages travel for Air Force people and equipment.
2t0x1.training: Tech school: Ft. Lee, VA, 44 days

2t1x1.title: Ground Transportation
2t1x1.description: Drives and dispatches buses, trucks and other vehicles to move people and cargo, including in convoys overseas.
2t1x1.training: Tech school: Ft. Leonard Wood, MO, 30 days

2t2x1.title: Air Transportation
2t2x1.description: Loads and unloads cargo and passengers on military aircraft and runs air terminal operations.
2t2x1.training: Tech school: Ft. Lee, VA, 29 days

2t3x7.title: Fleet Management and Analysis
2t3x7.description: Manages the Air Force's vehicle fleets, tracking maintenance, costs and parts to keep vehicles available.
2t3x7.training: Tech school: Lackland AFB, TX, 33 days

2w0x1.title: Munitions Systems
2w0x1.description: Builds, stores, inspects and delivers bombs, missiles and other munitions for aircraft.
2w0x1.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 43 days

35bx.title: Band Officer
35bx.description: Commands and conducts Air Force bands and manages their musical programs.

35px.title: Public Affairs Officer
35px.description: Leads communication with the media and public and advises commanders on messaging.

38fx.title: Force Support Officer
38fx.description: Leads personnel, manpower, services and readiness programs that support Airmen and families.

3e5x1.title: Engineering
3e5x1.description: Assists civil engineers with surveying, drafting and construction plans for base facilities and infrastructure.
3e5x1.training: Tech school: Ft. Leonard Wood, MO, 71 days

3e6x1.title: Operations Management
3e6x1.description: Manages civil engineering work orders, materials and the data that keeps base maintenance organized.
3e6x1.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 28-43 days

3f0x1.title: Human Resources and Administration
3f0x1.description: Handles personnel records, assignments, promotions and administrative support for Airmen and their units.
3f0x1.training: Tech school: Keesler AFB, MS, 26 days

3f1x1.title: Services
3f1x1.description: Runs dining facilities, fitness centers, lodging and recreation programs, and handles mortuary affairs.
3f1x1.training: Tech school: Ft. Lee, VA, 29 days

3n0x6.title: Public Affairs
3n0x6.description: Tells the Air Force story through photos, video, writing and social media, and works with the news media.
3n0x6.training: Tech school: Ft. Meade, MD, 87 days

3n1x1.title: Regional Band
3n1x1.description: Performs as a professional musician in an Air Force band at ceremonies, concerts and community events.

3n2x1.title: Premier Band
3n2x1.description: Performs in The U.S. Air Force Band in Washington, D.C., the service's top musical unit, at high-profile national events.

52rx.title: Chaplain
52rx.description: Provides religious services, spiritual care and confidential counseling to Airmen of all faiths.

5r0x1.title: Religious Affairs
5r0x1.description: Supports chaplains by running chapel programs, helping Airmen in crisis and protecting the free exercise of religion.
5r0x1.training: Tech school: Keesler AFB, MS, 26 days

62ex.title: Developmental Engineer
62ex.description: Engineer who designs, develops and tests new aircraft, weapons, space and other systems.

63ax.title: Acquisition Manager
63ax.description: Manages programs that buy and field new weapons and systems, balancing cost, schedule and performance.

64px.title: Contracting Officer
64px.description: Leads the buying of goods and services and signs contracts on behalf of the government.

65fx.title: Financial Management Officer
65fx.description: Manages budgets and financial operations and advises commanders on resources.

65wx.title: Cost Analysis Officer
65wx.description: Estimates and analyzes the costs of programs and weapons systems to support decisions.

6c0x1.title: Contracting
6c0x1.description: Buys the goods and services the Air Force needs by writing, negotiating and managing contracts with businesses.
6c0x1.training: Tech school: Lackland AFB, TX, 40 days

6f0x1.title: Financial Management and Comptroller
6f0x1.description: Manages budgets, pay and travel payments, and helps leaders track how money is spent.
6f0x1.training: Tech school: Keesler AFB, MS, 57 days

8g000.title: Honor Guard
8g000.description: Represents the Air Force at funerals, ceremonies and official events as a member of the ceremonial honor guard.

21ax.title: Aircraft Maintenance Officer
21ax.description: Leads aircraft maintenance units that keep the Air Force's jets safe and ready to fly.

2a3x3.title: Tactical Aircraft Maintenance
2a3x3.description: The crew chief for fighters like the F-15, F-16 and A-10, inspecting, servicing and launching jets every day.
2a3x3.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, length varies with aircraft

2a3x5.title: Advanced Fighter Aircraft Integrated Avionics
2a3x5.description: Maintains the highly integrated avionics on F-22 and F-35 fighters and on remotely piloted aircraft.

2a3x7.title: Tactical Aircraft Maintenance (5th Generation)
2a3x7.description: Crew chief for fifth-generation stealth fighters such as the F-22 and F-35, handling inspections, servicing and launches.

2a3x8.title: Remotely Piloted Aircraft Maintenance
2a3x8.description: Launches, recovers and maintains drones such as the MQ-9 Reaper and RQ-4 Global Hawk.
2a3x8.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, length varies with aircraft

2a5x1.title: Airlift/Special Mission Aircraft Maintenance
2a5x1.description: Crew chief for cargo and special-mission aircraft like the C-17, C-5 and C-130, keeping them inspected and ready to fly.
2a5x1.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, length varies with aircraft

2a5x2.title: Helicopter/Tiltrotor Aircraft Maintenance
2a5x2.description: Maintains Air Force helicopters and the CV-22 Osprey tiltrotor, from rotor systems to engines.
2a5x2.training: Tech school location and length vary with aircraft

2a5x4.title: Refuel/Bomber Aircraft Maintenance
2a5x4.description: Crew chief for tankers and bombers like the KC-135, KC-46, B-52, B-1 and B-2.
2a5x4.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, length varies with aircraft

2a6x1.title: Aerospace Propulsion
2a6x1.description: Inspects, repairs and tests jet engines and turboprops, both on the aircraft and in engine shops.
2a6x1.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 34-61 days

2a6x2.title: Aerospace Ground Equipment
2a6x2.description: Maintains the generators, air conditioners, hydraulic carts and other ground equipment used to service aircraft.
2a6x2.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 95 days

2a6x3.title: Aircrew Egress Systems
2a6x3.description: Maintains ejection seats and canopy systems that let aircrew escape a damaged aircraft.
2a6x3.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 31 days

2a6x4.title: Aircraft Fuel Systems
2a6x4.description: Repairs aircraft fuel tanks, lines and pumps, often working inside the tanks themselves.
2a6x4.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 36 days

2a6x5.title: Aircraft Hydraulic Systems
2a6x5.description: Maintains the hydraulic systems that move landing gear, flight controls and brakes.
2a6x5.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 49 days

2a6x6.title: Aircraft Electrical and Environmental Systems
2a6x6.description: Troubleshoots aircraft wiring, lighting, oxygen, cooling and pressurization systems.
2a6x6.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 91 days

2a7x1.title: Aircraft Metals Technology
2a7x1.description: Machines and welds metal parts and tools to repair aircraft and support equipment.
2a7x1.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 67 days

2a7x2.title: Nondestructive Inspection
2a7x2.description: Uses X-ray, ultrasound and other methods to find hidden cracks and corrosion in aircraft without taking them apart.
2a7x2.training: Tech school: Pensacola NAS, FL, 49 days

2a7x3.title: Aircraft Structural Maintenance
2a7x3.description: Repairs aircraft skins and structures, fixes corrosion and applies protective coatings and paint.
2a7x3.training: Tech school: Pensacola NAS, FL, 76 days

2a7x5.title: Low Observable Aircraft Structural Maintenance
2a7x5.description: Maintains the special stealth coatings and materials that keep aircraft like the F-22, F-35 and B-2 hard to detect.
2a7x5.training: Tech school: Pensacola NAS, FL, 60 days

2m0x3.title: Missile and Space Facilities
2m0x3.description: Maintains the power, environmental and support systems in ICBM launch facilities and space sites.
2m0x3.training: Tech school: Vandenberg SFB, CA, 73 days

2t3x1.title: Mission Generation Vehicular Equipment Maintenance
2t3x1.description: Repairs the fire trucks, refuelers, cargo loaders and other special vehicles that support flight operations.
2t3x1.training: Tech school: Port Hueneme, CA, 79 days

32ex.title: Civil Engineer
32ex.description: Engineer who plans, builds and maintains base infrastructure and leads engineering teams.

3e0x1.title: Electrical Systems
3e0x1.description: Installs and maintains base power lines, wiring, airfield lighting and electrical systems.
3e0x1.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 99 days

3e0x2.title: Electrical Power Production
3e0x2.description: Runs and repairs generators and aircraft arresting systems that provide backup power and stop jets on the runway.
3e0x2.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 55 days

3e1x1.title: Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning and Refrigeration
3e1x1.description: Installs and repairs heating, cooling and refrigeration systems in base facilities.
3e1x1.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 98 days

3e2x1.title: Pavements and Construction Equipment
3e2x1.description: Operates heavy equipment to build and repair runways, roads and other paved surfaces.
3e2x1.training: Tech school: Ft. Leonard Wood, MO, 61 days

3e3x1.title: Structural
3e3x1.description: Builds and repairs base buildings using carpentry, masonry, metalwork and other construction trades.

3e4x1.title: Water and Fuel Systems Maintenance
3e4x1.description: Maintains water treatment, plumbing, wastewater and fuel distribution systems on base.
3e4x1.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 86 days

3e4x3.title: Pest Management
3e4x3.description: Controls insects, rodents and other pests that threaten health, food and facilities.
3e4x3.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 33 days

13nx.title: Nuclear and Missile Operations Officer
13nx.description: Stands alert in underground launch control centers, ready to operate ICBMs.

13sx.title: Space Operations Officer
13sx.description: Operates and manages satellites, missile warning and other space systems.

15ax.title: Operations Analyst
15ax.description: Uses math, modeling and data science to help leaders make better operational decisions.

1c8x3.title: Radar, Airfield & Weather Systems
1c8x3.description: Maintains air traffic control radars, navigation aids and weather sensors that airfields rely on.
1c8x3.training: Tech school: Keesler AFB, MS (length not stated)

1d7x2.title: Radio Frequency Transmissions and Electromagnetic Activities
1d7x2.description: Installs and maintains radio, satellite and other wireless communication systems and manages the electromagnetic spectrum.
1d7x2.training: Tech school: Keesler AFB, MS, 96 days

1d7x3.title: Cable and Antenna Defense Operations
1d7x3.description: Installs and repairs the fiber, copper cable and antenna systems that carry Air Force communications.
1d7x3.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 80 days

1n8x1.title: Targeting Analyst
1n8x1.description: Researches potential targets, recommends the right weapons and assesses strike results so missions hit what they are supposed to.
1n8x1.training: Tech school: Goodfellow AFB, TX (length not stated)

21mx.title: Munitions and Missile Maintenance Officer
21mx.description: Leads units that maintain conventional munitions, nuclear weapons or ICBMs.

2a0x1.title: Avionics Test Station and Components
2a0x1.description: Repairs avionics components and electronic-warfare pods in the shop using specialized automated test stations.
2a0x1.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 73-90 days

2m0x1.title: Missile and Space Systems Electronic Maintenance
2m0x1.description: Maintains the electronic guidance and control systems of ICBMs and air-launched cruise missiles.
2m0x1.training: Tech school: Vandenberg SFB, CA, 59 days

2m0x2.title: Missile and Space Systems Maintenance
2m0x2.description: Handles, transports and maintains ICBM missiles and their launch facilities.
2m0x2.training: Tech school: Vandenberg SFB, CA, 70 days

2p0x1.title: Precision Measurement Equipment Laboratory
2p0x1.description: Calibrates and repairs the test and measurement equipment that maintainers use, so every reading is accurate.
2p0x1.training: Tech school: Keesler AFB, MS, 124 days

2w1x1.title: Aircraft Armament Systems
2w1x1.description: Loads bombs, missiles and ammunition onto aircraft and maintains the guns and weapons-release systems.
2w1x1.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 45-86 days

2w2x1.title: Nuclear Weapons
2w2x1.description: Maintains, inspects and handles nuclear weapons and their components under strict safety and security rules.
2w2x1.training: Tech school: Sheppard AFB, TX, 57 days

4a2x1.title: Biomedical Equipment
4a2x1.description: Installs, calibrates and repairs medical equipment such as monitors, imaging machines and lab instruments.

61cx.title: Chemist/Nuclear Chemist
61cx.description: Scientist who conducts chemical research and analysis for weapons, materials and treaty monitoring.

61dx.title: Physicist/Nuclear Engineer
61dx.description: Scientist who applies physics and nuclear engineering to research and develop new technologies.

19zxa.title: Special Tactics Officer
